description: May 6 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 6 birthday falls in Taurus, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The May 6 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Right at the midpoint of Taurus, the 6th of May pairs Venus's own sign with the number most linked to home and care. Six tends to point towards responsibility for others, and the Mercury-flavoured second decan adds practical good sense. Interpretive traditions describe a natural keeper of households and friendships, generous with time, though sometimes slow to ask for help in return.

Astronomically, May 6 puts the Sun near 15° Taurus in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Mercury, the ruler of Virgo, acts as sub-ruler for Taurus between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of May. That pairing brings a practical intelligence to the sign's patience. These Taureans are frequently pictured as craftspeople at heart: they like to learn how something works, refine it and make it last. Speech tends to be measured and grounded in specifics. The Virgoan undertone can add a critical eye, which is helpful in a workshop or a spreadsheet and sometimes less welcome at the dinner table. Their gift is turning ideas into durable, useful things that other people can rely on for years.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 6
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 6 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 6 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 6 is the 126th day of the year (127th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 15 days, by May 21.

By May 6 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 6 birthday are Sigmund Freud (1856), Tony Blair (1953) and Maximilien Robespierre (1758).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 6?
faq.answer: May 6 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 6 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 6?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 6, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 6?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 6 include Sigmund Freud (1856), Tony Blair (1953) and Maximilien Robespierre (1758). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
